primary: geometric matched whole-block gain across factory-quiet and panel-quiet, Circuit at 48k/64; both per-case lower bounds positive.
scope: CPU around real Engine::render only (not plugin or DAW), each fresh process, one inherited eligible CPU pinned. All seven sums and all output hashes retained. No time claim on other platforms.
criteria: pooled primary lower95 > max(2%, max absolute pooled A/A gain, 3x maximum measured empty clock fraction in primary). Every nonprimary lower CI >= -3%. No switch to held workload, retry, replacement, or deletion on failure.
baseline: e9e8175f4278d2457279fcb8809cbba1ddb7be2b shipping sources, identical to new research-only main tree.
schedule: 2 stock-only ABBA blocks then 6 ABBA comparisons, for each block cases in listed order, 4 slots per case (224 fresh processes).
per_slot: warm 8192 frames + measure 65536 frames (1024 64-frame calls) and 1024 empty clock pairs, no clock subtraction. 12 s wall per slot / 600 s global.
analysis: unadjusted thread CPU per frame, blocks of log A/B ratios -> reduction; shared-block 10000 draws, seed 20261118, linear 2.5/97.5 percentiles
